appliedUpdates.description: Added documentation about TokenAccountant not being instantiated in production.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Explicitly warn against running the full `pnpm test` suite during general verification due to extreme runtimes (400+ sec). Suggest targeted runs `node --test tests/...` instead.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature verify-reflection-loop-and-queue timed out after 180s running full tests. Previous milestone workers had to be explicitly told not to run it.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Remind workers that they are running in Windows PowerShell, so `&&` chaining does not work natively like in bash. They should use `;` or separate commands.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature verify-reflection-loop-and-queue initially failed due to `cd ... && ...` syntax.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Remind workers that targeted tests should be run using native Node syntax `node --test tests/...` rather than Jest-style arguments like `pnpm test:framework --testPathPattern=...` which can cause timeouts.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature fix-token-accountant-persistence-wiring initially timed out trying to run targeted tests using Jest-style arguments before pivoting to native Node syntax.
